data.long_meaning: Emelda is a name of Old German origin meaning 'Strong in God'. Its meaning is derived from the Old High German words 'em' meaning 'mighty' and 'ald' meaning 'God'. Emelda's spiritual meaning is a symbol of faith and strength in the divine. The name Emelda carries the meaning “Strong in God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Emelda usually hope their child will grow to embody strong in god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
